text.tspan: Located in East Asia, Japan is an island nation with a population of
approximately 125 million. Its capital is Tokyo and its official
currency is the Japanese Yen (¥).
Japan Culture:
Traditional arts coexist with cutting-edge technology. From ancient
temples and tea ceremonies to bullet trains and robotics, Japan
offers a unique blend of heritage and innovation. Experience world-
class cuisine, seasonal beauty, and renowned hospitality.
Economy & Innovation:

Japan maintains its position as the world's third-largest economy, driven by advanced manufacturing, technology, and automotive industries. Despite recent currency fluctuations, Japan remains a global leader in innovation, robotics, and sustainable technology development.
Japan's nominal GDP has shown resilience
over the past decade, peaking at $5.12
trillion in 2019. Recent years reflect
currency exchange impacts and global
economic shifts. The economy continues
to adapt with focus on digital trans-
formation and green initiatives.
Source: World Bank, IMF estimates
Values in current US$ trillions
2024 figures are preliminary

g.text: Vibrant metropolis blending tradition and cutting-edge tech
Historic temples, geisha culture, and seasonal gardens
Culinary heartland with lively street food and nightlife
Peace memorial and sacred island with floating torii
Iconic volcano and hot spring resort area
Pristine nature, winter sports, and dairy-rich cuisine

svg.text: Sources: World Bank, IMF, Statistics Bureau of Japan, 2024 | GDP figures in current US$ trillions | Population data 2024
